value.headline: Agreed to a five-year, $110 million contract extension
value.quote: On April 26, 2013, the Packers and Rodgers agreed to a 5-year, $110 million contract extension making him the highest paid player in NFL history.

value.headline: Signed a four-year, $134 million contract extension
value.quote: On August 29, 2018, Rodgers signed a four-year extension with the Packers worth $134 million featuring a $57.5 million signing bonus.

value.headline: Traded to the New York Jets
value.quote: On April 26, 2023, Rodgers was traded to the Jets, along with the Packers' first and fifth-round selections in the 2023 NFL draft, in exchange for the Jets' first, second (via Cleveland) and sixth-round selections in the 2023 draft and a conditional second-round selection (which would have converted to a first if Rodgers played 65% of the offensive snaps in 2023, but it did not happen) in the 2024 NFL draft.
The Jets therefore kept him on the roster until March 12, the start of the 2025 NFL year, when they officially released him.
However, on December 19, Rodgers was placed back on injured reserve after the Packers were eliminated from playoff contention.

value.headline: Signed a reworked two-year, $75 million contract

value.headline: Signed a one-year, $13.65 million contract
value.quote: On June 6, 2025, the Pittsburgh Steelers agreed to terms with Rodgers on a one-year deal. The following day, he officially signed his one-year, $13.65 million contract, which includes $10 million guaranteed and can be worth up to $19.5 million with incentives.
On May 16, 2026, Rodgers returned to the Steelers for his 22nd season, signing a one-year deal worth up to $25 million.

value.headline: Activated from the reserve/COVID-19 list by the Green Bay Packers
value.quote: Rodgers was activated off the reserve/COVID-19 list on November 13, and returned to play the next day against the Seahawks, a game the Packers won 17–0.

He was activated off injured reserve on December 20, but the Jets announced he would not play again this season after their Week 15 loss to the Dolphins mathematically eliminated them from playoff contention.
